localizedValues.name: Backcountry
localizedValues.description: Permit registration allows for overnight backcountry camping year-round in most areas within Tweedsmuir Park. Camping permits and canoe rentals for the Turner Lake Canoe Circuit must be paid through the Park Operator. More details can be found at bcparks.ca/tweedsmuir-park/turner-lake-canoe-circuit/ and www.tweedsmuirair.com/. Frontcountry camping at Fisheries Pool and Atnarko must be paid for in person and is first-come, first-served.
